items.t: Hybrid system shuts down with "Stop Safely Now"
items.job: Diagnose high-voltage system and replace failed part (often DC/DC converter or inverter-related part)
items.note: Cost depends on which part failed. CarComplaints owners report an average near $8,000 for stall repairs on 2013 cars when large parts were replaced.

items.t: Power steering assist suddenly lost
items.job: Replace electric power steering gear (rack)
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $1,800 on average.

items.t: 12-volt battery dead, car won't start
items.job: Test and replace 12-volt battery; software update if needed

items.t: Battery drained by the built-in modem
items.job: Battery test and telematics module software update
items.note: Price assumes battery replacement may also be needed.

items.t: Shifter cable bushing failure (recall)
items.job: Replace shift cable bushing and add protective cap
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall.

items.t: Transmission thumping or grinding noise
items.job: Diagnose and repair or replace HF35 hybrid transmission
items.note: Low end is an inspection and internal clean-out; high end is a replacement transmission.

items.t: Door may not latch or may open while driving (recall)
items.job: Replace side door latches
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall.

items.t: Airbag control module may short out (recall)
items.job: Replace restraint control module
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall.

items.t: Steering gear assembled incorrectly (recall)
items.job: Replace steering gear
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall.

items.t: Car keeps running after it is switched off (recall)
items.job: Update body control module software
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall.

items.t: Poorly welded front floor pan (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair floor pan apron welds
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall.

items.t: Backup camera image blank or distorted (recall)
items.job: Replace rearview camera
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall.

items.t: Portable charging cord can overheat (recall)
items.job: Replace 120-volt charge cord
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall.

items.t: Energi stalls or won't crank
items.job: Diagnose and reprogram or repair hybrid controllers
items.note: Often fixed with software; a failed controller costs more.

items.t: Energi won't charge or electric range drops
items.job: Diagnose charging system; software update or charger/controller repair

items.t: No warning chime when driver door opens (recall)
items.job: Reprogram or repair door chime
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall.

items.t: Weak A/C from electric compressor fault
items.job: A/C diagnosis and recharge, or replace high-voltage electric A/C compressor
items.note: A recharge alone runs about $550-570 at YourMechanic; one owner was quoted $2,600 for the electric compressor.

items.t: Check engine light with camshaft codes
items.job: Diagnose codes; replace cam sensor or timing control solenoid, oil change

items.t: "Check fuel fill inlet" or evaporative leak light
items.job: Replace capless filler, purge valve or vapor canister
items.note: RepairPal lists purge valve replacement around $233-280 and vapor canister around $487-538.

items.t: MyFord Touch screen freezes or loses phone
items.job: Software update or module replacement

items.t: Water leak stains the headliner
items.job: Water leak test, reseal and replace headliner if stained

items.t: Leather seat cracks
items.job: Replace leather seat cover panel

items.t: Front suspension rattle
items.job: Replace front sway bar bushings or links

items.t: Car won't move from range sensor fault
items.job: Diagnose transmission range sensor circuit; repair wiring or transmission
